column1: Clause  2:    This  clause  inserts  new  section  122A    in  the  Code  of  Criminal  Procedure  Act,
No.  15  of  1979  and  the  legal  effect  of  the  amendment  is  to  enable  the  officer  in  charge  of  a
police  station  to  cause,  a  child  of,  or  above  twelve  years  of  age  and  under  fourteen,  alleged
to  have  committed  an  offence,  to  be  examined  with  the  consent  of  the  parent  or  guardian  of
such  child,  by  a  Government  medical  officer  or  other  expert  in  the  relevant  field,  in  order  to
assist  the  Magistrate  to  form  his  opinion  on  the  maturity  of  understanding  of  such  child,  to
act  in  compliance  with  the  provisions  of  section  76  of  the  Penal  Code.
